visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: instanceof Instead of Comparing Class Names
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The type of each object is found by comparing the text of its class name. Use instanceof, which is checked by the compiler. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A misspelt class-name string compiles fine and just never matches, while a misspelt type in instanceof is a compile error. instanceof also accepts subclasses, which the name comparison does not.
